constraints.selectionReceipt: selectionReceiptHash is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of direction-preview.json#/decision, the owner's 2026-10-19 selection; previewArtifactSha256 is the SHA-256 of direction-preview.json. The comparison was re-bound to brief.md after the factual trial-range correction (brief.md:42-43, direction trials 0-5,000); the owner's decision, the rendered previews and their hashes are unchanged
constraints.base: dark-instrument: three-pane shell (nav rail, content, activity or persistent inspector), dense sortable direction table, glyph status, one signal colour
absorbedFromResearchPaper: island-lane lineage chart: x = generation, one lane per island, sharing the generation axis and scrubber with Progress
Progress as small multiples with labelled, shared axes
data-sentence headline on the home page, generated from live data
constraints.themes: default dark; light theme delivered too, user-switchable and remembered
constraints.language: zh/en toggle on every surface; Sharpe, DSR and PBO stay English abbreviations; default language zh pending owner confirmation
constraints.status: text plus shape, never colour alone; fixed product words 待跑, 已选, 运行中, 待判定, 成立, 否定, 未定, 已确认, 未确认, 放弃
constraints.numbers: tabular right-aligned figures; scores and Sharpe 2 decimals, DSR 3, money $0.00, time YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC, missing value —
constraints.evidence: best record and noise bar share one scale across all directions
constraints.colour: graphite neutrals plus one signal orange; no decorative gradients, glass or meaningless icons
constraints.contrast: body text at least 4.5:1, large text and graphics at least 3:1, in both themes
constraints.behaviourDependency: @carbon/react 1.118, already pinned in app/package.json, is not in the governed catalog or provider registry; the owner's 2026-10-19 decision keeps it inside project-owned components for interaction and accessibility behaviour only, so it is recorded here and not as a fit-matrix candidate. Astro UXDS is removed.
constraints.charts: SVG/D3 with token-bound colours; 3D clusters on a code-split Canvas 2D projection, no WebGL engine
constraints.motion: static posture: no entrance animation, state changes instant under reduced motion
constraints.offline: fonts and libraries bundled locally; no CDN

provider:project-dom.reason: project-owned components render every visible style from the project's tokens
